risk.discharge.cheapText: You are about to select discharge in a cheap hour ({price}). You will empty the battery even though power is cheap now. Do you want to continue?

risk.hold.expensiveText: You are about to select Hold in an expensive hour ({price}). This means the battery will not discharge in this period while the power price is high. Do you want to continue?
risk.hold.nowVeryExpensive: Are you sure you want to set the battery to Hold now? This means the battery will not discharge while the power price is very high ({price}) this hour.
risk.hold.nowExpensive: Are you sure you want to set the battery to Hold now? This means the battery will not discharge while the power price is high ({price}) this hour.
